note: Every game system the mashup touches, and how.

rows.how: Sonic's physics runs inside Pizza Tower's states 0, 92 and 65
kills go through the game's own Instakill, so the combo counts and drains exactly as for Peppino
the ball destroys anything breakable it touches
sounds sheet: each event plays a Mania sound, is muted, or keeps its own

rows.sonic_mania: Ring sprite, Ring and LoseRings sounds
rows.how: pickups add rings, a hit scatters them to grab back
game's taunt runs, Sonic is drawn in a pose from taunt_poses
Sonic Tower keeps its own saves folder and leaves the player's alone
the game's HUD stays, with Sonic and a ring count added
Sonic zooms up from where he stood at the exit into his victory pose; the game's own letter and words are cut out of its rank art and drawn beside him
the file select draws Sonic in Peppino's place and follows the same states; the boss VS art is rebuilt from Sonic's frames while the game runs

rows.pizza_tower: the file select, words naming Peppino
rows.sonic_mania: Tails and Knux sprites, Flying, Tired and Grab sounds
rows.how: up and down on the file select picks Sonic and Tails, Sonic, Tails or Knuckles; each plays with its own Mania ability and every screen that shows the player follows
